regions.text: Brazilian markets rallied after Lula tapped Bradesco chairman for finance chief.

regions.name: ASIA
regions.text: China's stocks surged after Beijing vowed stronger market support.

regions.name: THE AMERICAS
regions.text: The US goods trade deficit, buying more than selling, had an October deficit of more than 10%.

cover_dek: A man received a suspended sentence over a fake £154m company takeover bid.
big_headline: A man received a 2-year suspended prison sentence for staging a fake takeover bid.
big_body: Christopher Woolcott built a stake in Touchstone, an oil firm. He used Chat GPT to forge documents to raise its share price, or stock value.
pol_body: The UK raised its surcharge, an extra tax on bank profits, from 3% to 6% for 15 months. The Bank of England warned banks may pass the £1.5bn cost to customers.
biz_body: An auction accepted 12,000 crore rupees for 6.57% GS 2033. The cut-off price was 96.30 with a yield of 7.2736%.
up_body: Ethereum developers set the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet for December 15, after security concerns halted it in October.
